lines.en: Um, I don't know how to tell you this, but we have a little bit of a problem.
The minister just told me that it's tradition for the bestish mensch to be older than the groom.
I've never heard of such a thing.
I haven't heard of it, obviously.
But I'm out, because I'm significantly younger than you.
It's not significant as a big word.
I can't be there for you.
I just really wish there was something I could do.
